items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: I see him once in a while.

ctx.x: I see him once in a while.
Would you want to find him? Yeah, we'd like to talk to him too.

items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Mr. Sidney Brown, who came over yesterday, said you were about 80.

ctx.x: Mr. Sidney Brown, who came over yesterday, said you were about 80. He felt. I'd be 80 years old on Christmas the 25th. This coming Christmas. This coming Christmas. Next time. Born on Christmas Day, Mr. Kelly. Yes, sir. I believe Jim Robinson was born on Christmas Day, too. I think he was born on the same day. Well, he's younger. He's younger. Yeah, he's about... He's younger than me. About 67 or 68, something like that, this year. So, can you tell us just what town or what... Was that on the plantation down at…
That's right. On the plantation. Down at Deer Ring. The plantation.
